svg.title: Inside one SparkRing serving container
svg.desc: Every DGX Spark runs the same serving container as one tensor-parallel rank. SparkRing's entrypoint checks the image and starts vLLM with B12X kernels. Inside vLLM, SparkRing adds a runtime-status plugin and, for the Qwen profiles, a collective policy, prefill hooks, hyper-connection token-row prefill ownership and a GB10 decode layer. Collectives run on the paced RoCEnante transport or on NCCL 2.32.3. The right side summarises the two models, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash: hybrid linear- and sparse-attention mixture-of-experts models with hyper-connections and a one-layer MTP draft head.
